_comment: Proposed cron entries to splice into vercel.json (top-level 'crons' array) when ready to activate. Times are UTC. Vercel Hobby tier supports daily crons; Pro allows finer schedules.
_activation: Copy the 'crons' array below into vercel.json at top level (sibling of 'redirects'), commit, push. Vercel auto-registers schedules on next prod deploy.
_auth: Vercel injects CRON_SECRET into requests as Authorization: Bearer <secret>. Set CRON_SECRET in Vercel project env to enable verification (skipped automatically in dev/preview when unset).
